name: migrate-jsu-rules-dc-to-cloud
description: Migrate JSU (Jira Suite Utilities) workflow rules from Jira DC into Jira Cloud by converting them to native Cloud rules or JMWE equivalents and updating same-named Cloud workflows in place.

scripts.syntax-check: for f in main/migrate_jsu_rules.js src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo ALL_OK
